en.title: A Million Compiles. One Robot Hour. | Rust China Conf
en.description: A robot lifts the cube but violates its freshness contract. Follow the Rust repair, a fresh build through Incredibuild, and the recorded simulator evidence.
en.conference_title: A Million Compiles. One Robot Hour.
en.headline: The robot succeeded. The contract failed.
en.lead: Four motion segments ran on observations that were 600 ms old. Repair the Rust gate, rebuild in a fresh workspace, and check what the robot actually does.
en.hero_scope: A software-in-the-loop demonstration. Recorded evidence, inspectable source, no physical robot.
en.video_alt: Recorded simulator footage of a Panda arm approaching, grasping, and lifting a cube.
en.footage_caption: Play the real simulator footage. Rust authorizes each motion segment. This fresh-observation clip illustrates the task; the stale failure is replayed below.
en.behavior_title: Task success is only one check.
en.behavior_intro: The same 600 ms observation age produces two different decisions. The contract requires zero task dispatches when the observation is too old.
en.seeded_description: The missing freshness check permits all four segments. The cube lifts, even though the decision violates the policy.
en.patched_description: The repaired gate rejects the first stale proposal at tick 12. No task segment is dispatched.
en.payoff: With fresh observations, the same patched executable permits the motion and lifts the cube.
en.recorded_note: These are observations from the recorded Linux run, not live results from this browser.
en.stack_intro: Every candidate needs fresh validation. The architecture keeps the temporary workspace separate from the compilation service and retained evidence.
en.runner_body: A fresh Git checkout and Cargo output directory host the candidate. Export the patch and evidence before removing the workspace. The Linux host remains running.
en.ib_body: Cargo builds through ib_console with a rustc profile. The new Rust proof command consumes Build History remote-task counters and cache statistics, rejects incomplete telemetry, and computes ratios only after at least five samples per mode. A completed proof run is still required.
en.robot_body: Rust owns the policy, lock-step session, protocol identity, timeouts, evidence, verifier entry point, IB telemetry parser and benchmark gate. Python is retained only as the robosuite / MuJoCo simulator adapter and scripted motion source.
en.verifier_body: Contract tests and simulator checks execute again. The verifier checks required scenarios, ordered proposal/decision/outcome traces, and the exported executable’s digest. The agent’s own report is not the verdict.
en.provider: Execution today: EC2-backed Linux workspaces on the Incredibuild grid. Target runner provider: islo. The checked-in workflow does not call islo or destroy EC2 instances.
en.clock_title: Observation age and build duration use different clocks
en.clock_body: Observation age is simulation time minus capture time. The bridge advances at 20 Hz and requests authorization before each motion segment. A segment can contain several physics control steps. Build duration and protocol timeouts use wall time. This is not continuous control-step supervision.
en.rust_title: Rust is the control plane, not a label.
en.rust_intro: The conference path keeps policy and proof in Rust. The simulator boundary stays narrow and explicit.
en.rust_gate_body: Proposal, observation identity, simulated stop precedence, timestamp validity and StalePerception are Rust types and deterministic functions.
en.rust_session_body: Rust spawns the simulator adapter, binds one approval to one action and tick, rejects malformed messages, and treats timeout as failure rather than permission.
en.rust_proof_body: swf-cli parses IB Build History and cache counters, requires remote tasks and parent-warmed hits for every IB sample, then reports medians and ranges.
en.python_adapter_body: robosuite is Python-native, so Python steps MuJoCo and proposes scripted segments. It cannot authorize motion or declare the final verdict.
en.loop_title: A change has to earn its result.
en.loop_intro: The complete rehearsal retains the failure, applies a bounded candidate patch, rebuilds, and executes the checks on the resulting binary.
en.step1_body: Workspace A builds the seeded gate and records the wrongly permitted stale episode.
en.step2_body: Export the work order and base revision. Restrict the candidate patch to the gate implementation.
en.step3_body: Remove A’s workspace. Apply the patch to the recorded base in B with fresh Cargo outputs.
en.step4_body: Run the contract tests and full scenario matrix. Export the executable and verify its evidence.
en.agent_note: The automated rehearsal uses the reviewed fallback patch by default. An externally produced agent patch can be supplied explicitly; the script does not run an LLM.
en.value_title: Why this matters beyond one cube.
en.value_intro: The same loop serves systems research, agent research, and physical-AI work. A behavioral claim is worth exactly as much as the run that reproduces it.
en.value_research_body: Every experiment gets a fresh workspace, a recorded base revision, and exported evidence. A result that cannot be rebuilt from that recorded base is a screenshot, not a finding.
en.value_agent_body: An agent may propose the patch, but an allowlist bounds what it can touch and a protected verifier issues the verdict. A self-reported success is not a result.
en.value_physical_body: Simulation is where a policy violation is cheap. This run shows a successful lift that still failed its freshness contract — exactly the failure class you do not want to meet first on hardware.
en.value_build_body: Incredibuild is integrated into this loop, and the controlled experiment that would measure distribution and cache reuse now exists in Rust. Until that experiment produces a receipt, the speedup stays unmeasured.
en.evidence_intro: Five cube placements and three observation ages, plus simulated stop and protocol timeout. The table is generated from the committed scenario results.
en.matrix_label: Recorded scenario results; scroll horizontally to see all observation ages
en.matrix_caption: Observation age at dispatch. Tick counts come from the recorded episode results.
en.matrix_extra: Additional cases: simulated stop → emergency_stop; bridge stall → timeout. Total: 10 lifts, 5 stale rejections, 1 stop, 1 timeout.
en.phase_b_flag: 522 ms SLOWER than A · no speedup established
en.measurement_note: One sample per phase, taken from the archived run with caches uncontrolled. B took 522 ms longer than A. Both records indicate Incredibuild use. These two observations demonstrate that the integration path ran; they establish no speedup and are not a controlled cache or performance measurement.
en.provenance_body: The historical run reported 10/10 Rust gate tests and 88/88 checks under the original verifier. Those counts describe that revision, not the strengthened current suite. The repository contains traces, manifests, build timings, and the recorded executable digest. The executable itself is not committed, so a clone cannot independently recheck that historical binary. A new rehearsal exports its own verifiable artifact.
en.scope_title: The boundary is part of the result.
en.scope_body: This demonstrates Rust contract checks and simulated robot behavior. Cube positions come from simulator state. The 250 ms threshold is an illustrative policy. Physical robots, hardware-in-the-loop, trained vision, continuous emergency-stop supervision, and a measured performance benefit remain outside the demonstrated scope.
en.offline: Both language editions, fonts, media, and replay work from a local copy of docs/. Keep one on the presenter’s laptop.

zh.title: 百万次编译，一小时机器人 | Rust China Conf
zh.description: 机器人举起了方块，却违反了观测时效约束。查看 Rust 修复、Incredibuild 重建流程，以及记录下来的仿真证据。
zh.conference_title: 百万次编译，一小时机器人
zh.headline: 机器人成功了，契约却失败了。
zh.lead: 四段运动使用的观测都已过期 600 ms。修复 Rust 决策门，在全新工作区重建，再检查机器人实际执行了什么。
zh.hero_scope: 软件在环演示。提供运行记录与源码，不涉及实体机器人。
zh.footage_label: 新鲜观测 · 录制画面
zh.video_alt: Panda 机械臂接近、抓取并举起方块的仿真录像。
zh.footage_caption: 点击播放真实仿真画面。每段运动先经 Rust 授权。这段新鲜观测录像用于说明任务；陈旧观测导致的缺陷可在下方回放。
zh.behavior_title: 任务成功，只是一项检查。
zh.behavior_intro: 同样是 600 ms 的观测年龄，两个构建给出不同决策。契约要求：观测过旧时，不得派发任务动作。
zh.seeded_description: 缺失的时效检查放行了全部四段运动。方块成功举起，但决策违反了策略。
zh.patched_description: 修复后的决策门在 tick 12 拒绝第一个陈旧提案，没有派发任何任务动作。
zh.patched_trace: 修复后陈旧观测回合的记录
zh.payoff: 换成新鲜观测，同一个修复后的可执行文件会放行运动并举起方块。
zh.recorded_note: 这里展示的是已记录的 Linux 运行结果，并非浏览器正在执行的实时测试。
zh.stack_title: 工作区可丢弃，编译成果可复用。
zh.stack_intro: 每个候选改动都要重新验证。架构将临时工作区、编译服务和保留的证据分开管理。
zh.runner_body: 候选改动使用全新的 Git 检出和 Cargo 输出目录。导出补丁与证据后删除工作区，Linux 主机继续运行。
zh.ib_body: Cargo 通过 ib_console 与 rustc 配置构建。新的 Rust 证明命令读取 Build History 的远程任务计数与缓存统计；遥测不完整就失败，并且每种模式至少五次后才计算比率。仍需完成一次真实证明运行。
zh.robot_body: 策略、锁步会话、协议身份、超时、证据、校验入口、IB 遥测解析和基准门都由 Rust 负责。Python 只保留为 robosuite / MuJoCo 仿真适配器与脚本运动来源。
zh.verifier_body: 契约测试与仿真检查重新执行。校验器检查必需场景、按顺序记录的提案／决策／结果，以及导出文件的摘要。智能体自己的报告不能替代检查结论。
zh.provider: 当前执行环境：Incredibuild 网格上的 EC2 Linux 工作区。未来运行器提供方：islo。仓库现有流程不会调用 islo，也不会销毁 EC2 实例。
zh.clock_title: 观测年龄与构建耗时使用不同的时钟
zh.clock_body: 观测年龄等于仿真时间减去采集时间。桥接程序以 20 Hz 推进仿真，在每段运动前请求授权；一段运动可能包含多个控制步。构建耗时与协议超时使用墙上时间。本演示不提供逐控制步的连续监督。
zh.rust_title: Rust 是控制平面，不是标签。
zh.rust_intro: 会议路径把策略与证明放在 Rust 中；仿真边界保持狭窄且明确。
zh.rust_gate_body: 提案、观测身份、仿真停止优先、时间戳有效性与 StalePerception 都是 Rust 类型和确定性函数。
zh.rust_session_body: Rust 启动仿真适配器，把一次批准绑定到一个 action 与 tick，拒绝畸形消息，并把超时视为失败而不是许可。
zh.rust_proof_body: swf-cli 解析 IB Build History 与缓存计数；每个 IB 样本都必须有远程任务，父修订预热样本必须有命中，然后才报告中位数与范围。
zh.python_adapter_body: robosuite 原生使用 Python，因此 Python 负责 MuJoCo 步进并提出脚本化运动段；它不能授权运动，也不能给出最终结论。
zh.loop_title: 每个改动，都要重新验证。
zh.loop_intro: 完整彩排保留失败记录，应用受约束的候选补丁，重新构建，并对生成的可执行文件执行检查。
zh.step1_body: 工作区 A 构建植入缺陷的版本，记录错误放行陈旧观测的回合。
zh.step2_body: 导出工单与基线修订。候选补丁只能修改决策门的实现。
zh.step3_body: 删除 A 的工作区。在 B 中检出记录的基线，应用补丁，使用全新 Cargo 输出。
zh.step4_body: 执行契约测试与完整场景矩阵，导出可执行文件并校验证据。
zh.agent_note: 自动彩排默认使用已审阅的回退补丁，也可显式传入外部智能体生成的补丁。脚本本身不调用大语言模型。
zh.value_intro: 同一套闭环同时服务系统研究、智能体研究与物理 AI 工作。一个行为结论的价值，等于能把它重新跑出来的那次运行。
zh.value_research_body: 每次实验都使用全新工作区、记录下来的基线修订和导出的证据。无法从该基线重建的结果只是截图，不是结论。
zh.value_agent_body: 智能体可以提出补丁，但白名单限定它能改动的范围，最终结论由受保护的校验器给出。智能体自述的成功不算结果。
zh.value_physical_body: 仿真阶段发现策略违规的代价最低。本次运行展示了“成功举起却违反时效契约”的回合——这正是你不希望在真实硬件上第一次遇到的失败类型。
zh.value_build_body: Incredibuild 已接入该闭环，用于测量分布式执行与缓存复用的受控实验也已用 Rust 实现。在该实验产出收据之前，加速幅度仍未测量。
zh.evidence_intro: 五个方块位置、三种观测年龄，另加仿真停止与协议超时。表格直接从已提交的场景结果生成。
zh.recorded_run: 已记录的 Linux 运行：
zh.matrix_label: 已记录的场景结果；可横向滚动查看全部观测年龄
zh.matrix_caption: 派发时的观测年龄。tick 数来自记录中的回合结果。
zh.matrix_extra: 其他场景：仿真停止 → emergency_stop；桥接停顿 → timeout。合计：10 次举起、5 次陈旧拒绝、1 次停止、1 次超时。
zh.phase_a: 运行器 A 构建阶段
zh.phase_a_flag: 单次未受控采样 · 归档历史运行
zh.phase_b: 运行器 B 构建阶段
zh.phase_b_flag: 比 A 慢 522 ms · 未确立任何加速
zh.measurement_note: 每个阶段各只有一次采样，来自归档运行，缓存未受控。B 比 A 多用了 522 ms。两个记录均标明使用了 Incredibuild。这些观测只能说明集成路径已运行；它们不能确立任何加速，也不是受控缓存实验或性能测量。
zh.provenance_body: 历史运行在原校验器下报告了 10/10 项 Rust 决策门测试与 88/88 项检查。这些数字属于当时的修订，不代表当前加强后的测试套件。仓库保留轨迹、清单、构建计时和可执行文件摘要；没有提交可执行文件本体，因此仅克隆仓库无法重新核对该历史二进制。新彩排会导出自己的可核验产物。
zh.scope_title: 结果的适用范围，也要说清楚。
zh.scope_body: 本演示覆盖 Rust 契约检查与仿真机器人行为。方块位置来自仿真器状态，250 ms 是示例策略。实体机器人、硬件在环、训练视觉、连续急停监督及已测得的性能收益，均不在已演示范围内。
zh.offline: 两种语言、字体、媒体和回放均可从 docs/ 本地副本打开。请在演讲电脑上保留一份。
